messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] health-checkers-eu-west-1: 5xx-rate > 5 in 2m. Auto-page to SRE rotation. PagerDuty incident PD-45215 created. Links: https://infra.alerts/redwood/PD-45215

j.park: acked PD-45215 :hand: on call. I'm looking. Any customer reports?

alex: seeing HTTP 502 from the health endpoint on three runner pods. Logs showing `upstream reset` in the last 30s. No other regions yet.

megan: on it — checking prober fleet. `kubectl -n probes get pods -l app=health-checker -o wide` shows 3/5 Ready in eu-west-1. Some crashloops on node gpu-23.

kyle: pinging infra: is there any autoscaler churn? I see a spike in node preemption events 1m ago.

ops-bot: Node event stream: node/gpu-23 NotReady -> kubelet restarted at 6880019072. evicted pods: health-checker-7d9c, health-checker-9b2f, health-checker-b2c1.

j.park: quick mitigation plan: 1) remove the failing node from the prober rotation 2) restart the health-checker deployment on eu-west-1 3) temporarily mute health-checkers-eu-west-1 alert rule for 10m to avoid noisy pages.

alex: agree. I'll cordon gpu-23 and drain gracefully: `kubectl cordon gpu-23 && kubectl drain gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

megan: restarting the deployment now. Command: ```kubectl -n probes rollout restart deployment/health-check-runner-eu-west-1```

kyle: after restart I'm seeing pods come up: health-check-runner-6f4a Pending -> Running. Doing a quick `curl -v https://health.euw1.redwood.internal/check`

alex: curl returns 200 now, 5ms. Good. The probe binary shows the previous error: `dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: connection reset by peer` — likely node-level transient. Also cleaned up docker overlay leftovers on the node.

incident-bot: PD-45215: acknowledged by j.park at 6880019010. Escalation suppressed.

j.park: muted the alert rule for 10m (muting id m-6880019120). We'll re-enable after stabilization.

megan: I've updated the status internal channel and posted a brief note to #general-ops. No direct customer-facing incidents reported — we should not update public status unless we see errors in API gateway metrics.

kyle: checking ingress metrics — 99.99% healthy, small spike in 5xx from eu-west-1 between 6880018980-6880019050, peaked at 0.8% for 40s. That's below our public-impact threshold.

alex: leaving a short remediation runbook in the incident thread: 1) cordon/drain node 2) restart deployment 3) verify probe health `curl` 4) unmute rule after 10m 5) follow-up note with PD ticket details.

j.park: handing off to tomorrow's day oncall (megan) in 20m. If anything flares up after mute expiry, escalate to oncall-manager.

megan: ack. I'll monitor for the next 15m and then take over. Adding to PD: `owner: megan` and tag `infra-prober`.
_meta: generated-by-ai: realistic slack thread about automated health-check paging and on-call coordination
